# Cartfull

> Cartfull is a web app that plans a week of dinners around a fixed grocery budget and turns the plan into a priced shopping list. Users set a weekly budget in dollars; Cartfull picks recipes whose real package prices fit that budget, sorts the list by store aisle, and tracks how much was saved versus typical spending.

## Key facts

- Product type: web application / progressive web app (no install needed, works offline in the store)
- URL: https://cartfull.click
- Languages: English (https://cartfull.click) and Spanish (https://cartfull.click/es)
- Price: free 7-day trial with no card required, then $9.99 USD per month or $49.99 USD per year; cancel any time
- Recipe catalog: 300+ recipes priced per package at typical US discount-grocer prices
- Diets supported: no preference, vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, keto, high-protein, low-carb, dairy-free, gluten-free; allergen and disliked-food exclusions
- Household sizing: plans scale to the number of people in the household
- Regional support: country selection with local units (metric or US) and appliance availability (oven, air fryer, microwave, slow cooker)

## What it does

1. The user enters their weekly grocery budget, household size, country and diet preferences.
2. Cartfull generates a week of dinners (optionally lunches and breakfasts) whose ingredients fit the budget, reusing packages across recipes so nothing bought goes unused.
3. The user receives one grocery list sorted by aisle, priced item by item, shareable live with family members.
4. After shopping, the user enters what they really spent; Cartfull tracks savings week over week against their usual spend.

## Differentiators

- Prices reflect whole packages, not fractional ingredient math: if a recipe needs half a bag of rice, the cart charges the whole bag once and reuses the rest.
- Per-serving nutrition (calories, protein, carbs, fat) based on USDA data.
- Cook mode: step-by-step full-screen cooking view with timers matched to each step.
- The grocery list works offline once loaded.

## Legal and contact

- Terms: https://cartfull.click/terms
- Privacy: https://cartfull.click/privacy
- Prices in the app are estimates, not live store quotes; Cartfull does not provide medical or nutrition advice.
